statement: For the iteration $x_{n+1}=\\cos x_{n}$ converging to the root $\\alpha$ of $x=\\cos x$, show that the error $e_{n}=\\alpha-x_{n}$ satisfies $e_{n+1}\\approx-\\sin\\alpha\,e_{n}$, and state the order of convergence.
solution: Since $\\alpha=\\cos\\alpha$, the error is $e_{n+1}=\\alpha-x_{n+1}=\\cos\\alpha-\\cos x_{n}$. Writing $x_{n}=\\alpha-e_{n}$ and using $\\cos(\\alpha-e_{n})\\approx\\cos\\alpha+e_{n}\\sin\\alpha$ gives $e_{n+1}\\approx\\cos\\alpha-(\\cos\\alpha+e_{n}\\sin\\alpha)=-e_{n}\\sin\\alpha$. Thus the errors shrink by a factor $|\sin\\alpha|\\approx0.674$ each step, so the convergence is linear (first order).
hints: Express e_{n+1} as cos alpha - cos x_n.
Expand cos(alpha - e_n) to first order in e_n.
Compare the coefficient to identify the convergence factor.
